verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent can be given runbooks, described as 'manuals to execute complex procedures', and the issue log records the 'steps taken by the AI'. That supports multi-step, scenario-specific handling rather than a single canned reply. Nothing in the evidence says the agent asks customers clarifying questions, and multi-step troubleshooting depth is only claimed in docs. missing for 10: documented clarifying-question behavior, explicit multi-turn troubleshooting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: Give your agents manuals to execute complex procedures.
Write instructions in natural language to help your AI Agent handle specific scenarios.
inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI
Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
